sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- The value of a dogtag depends on the owner's PMC and Prestige levels. When sold to Therapist, the value per level is as follows:
  - No Prestige: ₽459
  - Prestige 1: ₽535,5
  - Prestige 2: ₽561
  - Prestige 3: ₽586,5
  - Prestige 4: ₽612
  - Prestige 5: ₽612
  - Prestige 6: ₽612
- Dogtags obtained from group members sell for only ₽1, and will not be found in raid. They can, however, be used for barters.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
This item tells you the owner's name, level, faction, time of death, who killed them and the weapon used to kill them.
The number displayed in the bottom-left of a dogtag icon displays the level of its owner.

sections.heading: BEAR Exclusive
sections.text: - 20 USEC dogtags need to be found in raid for the quest Our Own Land

sections.heading: USEC Exclusive
sections.text: - 20 BEAR dogtags need to be found in raid for the quest Counteraction

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The default USEC version shows the following:

BROWN.
CHARLES WM.
US NAVY
4567822277
B POS NKA

"4567822277" is the fictitious military service number, "B POS" is the blood type with rhesus factor and "NKA" stands for "No Known Allergies".
